common.noResultsHint: Adjust your search, or create the first one.
common.confirmDeactivate: Deactivate {name}? It stays in the records and can be reactivated later.

auth.signInSubtitle: Use the account your store owner gave you.
auth.sessionExpired: Your session ended. Please sign in again.
auth.signedOutAfterPasswordChange: Password changed. Please sign in with your new password.
auth.changePasswordSubtitle: Pick something only you know. You will be asked to sign in again afterwards.
auth.mustChangePassword: You are still using a temporary password. Choose a new one to continue.
auth.passwordsDoNotMatch: The two passwords do not match
auth.acceptInviteSubtitle: Choose a password to finish joining the store.
auth.inviteAccepted: Your account is ready. Please sign in.
auth.missingToken: This invitation link is incomplete. Ask whoever invited you to send it again.
auth.platformOperatorBody: You are signed in as a platform operator, so no store is attached to this session. Stores are created and administered with the apexwms command line tool — there is no web portal for it yet.

products.title: Products
products.subtitle: Everything the store can buy or sell.
products.notFound: This product does not exist in this store.
products.skuHint: Stored upper-case and trimmed, so sku-001 and SKU-001 are the same product.
products.name: Name
products.barcodeHint: 8, 12, 13 or 14 digits with a valid check digit.
products.priceHintUzs: Whole so'm only — this currency has no minor unit.
products.noBarcodeForSerial: A serial product is identified by its IMEI, not by a barcode.
products.immutableAfterCreate: Tracking and currency are fixed once the product is created.

locations.title: Locations
locations.subtitle: The places in your store where stock sits.
locations.name: Name

customers.title: Customers
customers.subtitle: A name and a phone number — enough to put on an invoice.

staff.title: Staff
staff.subtitle: Who works at this store, and what they may do.
staff.name: Name
staff.inviteLinkHint: No email is sent yet — copy this link and give it to them yourself. It expires in 72 hours and works once.

roleHints.manager: Runs the store day to day. No staff management.
roleHints.storekeeper: Receives goods and counts stock. No sales, no customers.
roleHints.seller: Sells and manages customers. Cannot see cost.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Store-wide preferences.
settings.timezoneHint: An IANA timezone name, for example Asia/Tashkent.
settings.readOnly: Only the store owner can change these.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission to do that.

documents.subtotalsHint: One total per currency. Nothing is converted or added together.
documents.reasonHint: Kept with the reversal on the record. Optional.
documents.immutable: A confirmed document cannot be edited. Correct one by cancelling it and raising it again.
documents.cancelledNotice: This document was cancelled. Its movements were compensated, not deleted.
documents.priceHintUzs: Whole so'm only — this currency has no minor unit.

purchaseOrders.title: Purchase orders
purchaseOrders.subtitle: What the store has on order. Confirming an order fixes its numbers; it moves no stock.
purchaseOrders.notFound: This purchase order does not exist in this store.
purchaseOrders.linesRequired: An order needs at least one line.
purchaseOrders.priceLineHint: The line is priced in its product's currency.
purchaseOrders.unpricedWarning: Every line needs a price before this order can be confirmed.
purchaseOrders.confirmBody: Its lines and amounts become final. No stock moves — goods arrive on a receipt.
purchaseOrders.cancelBody: The order stays on record as cancelled.

receipts.title: Goods receipts
receipts.subtitle: What has arrived, and what is still being scanned. Stock moves when a receipt is confirmed.
receipts.notFound: This receipt does not exist in this store.
receipts.sourceHint: Used stock is bought from walk-in customers, not from suppliers.
receipts.customerHint: Optional — who the handset was bought from.
receipts.fromOrderHint: Lines come from the purchase order and cannot be changed here.
receipts.linesRequired: A receipt needs at least one line.
receipts.unitCostSerialHint: Serialized lines are priced per handset, as they are scanned.
receipts.confirmBody: The handsets enter stock and both ledgers are written. It cannot be edited afterwards.
receipts.cancelBody: Compensating movements are written; the original rows stay on record.
receipts.blockersTitle: This receipt cannot be confirmed yet
receipts.blockerUnpriced: {imei} is {condition} and carries no asking price

scan.title: Scan
scan.placeholder: Scan or type an IMEI, then press Enter
scan.hint: Keep the cursor here — the scanner types the code and presses Enter for you.
scan.conditionHint: Applies to the next handset scanned.
scan.cashPaidHint: What actually changed hands, when that differs from the booked cost. It enters no total.
scan.poReferenceHint: From the order: {price}. Change it if this handset costs something else.
scan.needsPriceHint: A used handset never inherits the catalog price. Someone with pricing rights must price it.
scan.readOnly: This receipt is closed — nothing more can be scanned onto it.
scan.allScanned: Every line is fully scanned — there is nothing left to scan.

deviceUnits.title: Handset
deviceUnits.notFound: No such handset in this store.
deviceUnits.notPricedHint: This handset resolves to no price, so it cannot be sold. An Owner or Manager must price it.
deviceUnits.cashPaidHint: Informational only — it enters no total, no margin and no report.
deviceUnits.repriceHint: Every change is recorded, and a price cannot be removed once set.
deviceUnits.changeConditionHint: Condition decides whether this handset may use the catalog price. Marking an unpriced handset as used makes it unsellable until it is priced.
deviceUnits.priceHistoryEmpty: This handset has never carried a price.
